rules.message: Import from `bootstrap-vue`; switch to `bootstrap-vue-next` (named component imports or the unplugin resolver).
Vue 2 global plugin install. Use `createApp(App)` + `<BApp>` (recommended), or `app.use(createBootstrap())` plus a `<BOrchestrator />` in the root template. Icon plugins have no equivalent.
BootstrapVue stylesheet. Import `bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.css` (Bootstrap 5) and `bootstrap-vue-next/dist/bootstrap-vue-next.css`.
BootstrapVue icon components were not carried over. Use unplugin-icons (e.g. `<IBiCheck />`) or bootstrap-icons.
Dependency used only by BootstrapVue; remove it unless your own code uses it.
`bootstrap-vue` dependency: remove it and add `bootstrap-vue-next` (Vue 3 + Bootstrap 5.3 required).
Bootstrap 4 (or older) dependency: BootstrapVueNext needs `bootstrap@^5.3`.
BootstrapVue Nuxt 2 module. Use `@bootstrap-vue-next/nuxt` on Nuxt 3+.

`$bvModal` was removed: use `useModal()` (`create`, `show`, `hide`) or a template ref. `show(id)` is unchanged but `hide(id)` → `hide(undefined, id)` (signature is `hide(trigger?, id?)`). `msgBoxOk`/`msgBoxConfirm` become `useModal().create({...}).show()`. Requires a `<BApp>` ancestor (not in the same component).
`$bvToast` was removed: use `useToast().create({ title, body, ... }).show()`; `hide(id)` → `useToast().hide(undefined, id)`. Requires a `<BApp>` ancestor (not in the same component).
`$root` `bv::` events are not supported in Vue 3 / BootstrapVueNext. Use composables (`useModal`, `useToggle`, `useToast`), template refs or v-model.
BootstrapVue plugin objects. Global prop defaults move to `<BApp :defaults>` or `createBootstrap({ components: {...} })`.
`.sync` is gone in Vue 3: use `v-model:<prop>` (and `v-model` for the primary model).
Vue 2 `slot=`/`slot-scope=` syntax: use `<template #name="scope">`.
`.native` modifier removed in Vue 3; listeners fall through as attrs.
`html` / `*-html` props were removed in favour of slots (use explicit `v-html` inside the slot if you must).
`BSidebar`: Renamed to `BOffcanvas` (`right` → `placement="end"`, `no-slide` → `no-animation`, `no-enforce-focus` → `no-trap`).
`BJumbotron`: Removed (dropped in Bootstrap 5). Rebuild with utility classes, e.g. `<div class="p-5 mb-4 bg-body-tertiary rounded-3">`.
`BMedia`: Removed. Use flex utilities (`d-flex`, `flex-shrink-0`, `flex-grow-1 ms-3`).
`BMediaAside`: Removed with BMedia. Use `<div class="flex-shrink-0">`.
`BMediaBody`: Removed with BMedia. Use `<div class="flex-grow-1 ms-3">`.
`BEmbed`: Removed. Use Bootstrap 5 `.ratio .ratio-16x9` classes (or `BAspect`).
`BPaginationNav`: Not implemented. Use `BPagination` with your router, or plain links.
`BImgLazy`: Removed. Use `<BImg lazy>` (native `loading="lazy"`).
`BCardImgLazy`: Removed. Use `<BCardImg>` / `<BImg lazy>`.
`BInputGroupAppend`: Removed (Bootstrap 5). Place children directly inside `BInputGroup`, or use the `append` slot / prop.
`BInputGroupPrepend`: Removed (Bootstrap 5). Place children directly inside `BInputGroup`, or use the `prepend` slot / prop.
`BInputGroupAddon`: Removed (Bootstrap 5). Place children directly inside `BInputGroup`.
`BToaster`: Removed. Toast placement/orchestration is handled by `<BApp>` + `useToast()` (or `<BOrchestrator>`).
`BSkeleton`: Removed. Use `BPlaceholder`.
`BSkeletonWrapper`: Removed. Use `BPlaceholderWrapper` (`loading` prop + `loading` slot).
`BSkeletonTable`: Removed. Use `BPlaceholderTable`.
`BSkeletonImg`: Removed. Use `BPlaceholderWrapper` / `BPlaceholder`.
`BSkeletonIcon`: Removed (icons not supported). Use `BPlaceholderWrapper` with your icon in the `loading` slot.
`BButtonClose`: Renamed to `BCloseButton`; `content` and `text-variant` props removed (Bootstrap 5 uses an SVG icon; use `variant="white"` style classes as needed).
`BFormDatepicker`: No stable equivalent. Experimental `BDatePicker` / `BDateField` exist with a different API — migrate manually or keep a third-party date picker.
`BCalendar`: No stable equivalent. Experimental `BDatePicker` has a different API — migrate manually.
`BFormTimepicker`: No stable equivalent. Experimental `BTimeField` has a different (segmented-field) API — migrate manually.
`BTime`: No stable equivalent. Experimental `BTimeField` has a different API — migrate manually.
`BCardSubTitle`: Renamed to `BCardSubtitle` (lower-case t); `sub-title*` props become `text` / `tag` / `text-variant` (and `subtitle*` on BCard).
`BFormRow`: Still exported but **deprecated**; renders `.row` with Bootstrap 5 gutters, not BS4 `.form-row` tight gutters. Prefer `<BRow class="g-2">` (verify spacing visually).

`v-b-hover` removed: use VueUse `useElementHover()`.
`v-b-visible` removed: use VueUse `useElementVisibility()`.
`v-b-tooltip` exists but modifiers/value handling changed; review placement and trigger modifiers.
`v-b-popover` exists but value object, triggers and `custom-class` (→ `body-class`) changed.
`v-b-modal` still exists (as `vBModal`); review if you relied on `$root` events.
BootstrapVue directive export. New names are camel-case `vBTooltip`, `vBPopover`, `vBModal`, `vBToggle`, `vBScrollspy` (hover/visible removed).
`hide-header-close` → `no-header-close` (BModal).
`hide-footer` → `no-footer` (BModal).
`hide-header` → `no-header` (BModal).
`hide-backdrop` → `no-backdrop` (BModal).
`no-enforce-focus` → `no-trap` (BModal).
`title-sr-only` → `title-visually-hidden` (BModal).
`aria-label` is removed/deprecated on BModal; see guide.
`auto-focus-button` is removed/deprecated on BModal; see guide.
`ignore-enforce-focus-selector` is removed/deprecated on BModal; see guide.
`custom-class` → `body-class` (BPopover).
`no-slide` → `no-animation` (BSidebar, BOffcanvas).
`toast-title` → `title` (BToast).
`toaster` is removed/deprecated on BToast; see guide.
`rounded="top"` → `rounded-top` prop (Bootstrap 5 start/end naming).
`rounded="bottom"` → `rounded-bottom` prop (Bootstrap 5 start/end naming).
`rounded="left"` → `rounded-start` prop (Bootstrap 5 start/end naming).
`rounded="right"` → `rounded-end` prop (Bootstrap 5 start/end naming).
`hide-ellipsis` → `no-ellipsis`.
`hide-goto-end-buttons` → `no-goto-end-buttons`.
`appear` → `initial-animation`.
`label-sr-only` → `label-visually-hidden`.
`title-sr-only` → `title-visually-hidden`.
BAlert `dismissed` event → `hidden` (any hide, incl. countdown expiry) or `close` (close button only) — there is NO `closed` event; `dismiss` slot → `close`.

`@input` / `@change` / `@update` on form controls (and BPagination) no longer receive the value: they are not component events, so the handler gets a native DOM `Event` or never fires. Use `@update:model-value`.
BAlert auto-dismiss changed units: numeric `show` was SECONDS, numeric `v-model` / `model-value` is MILLISECONDS. `@dismiss-count-down` (seconds) → `@close-countdown` (ms).

Possible BootstrapVue component method called through a ref. Renamed, moved or removed: `setSlide` → `slideTo`; table selection methods → `ref.selection.*`; BTabs navigation methods gone (use `v-model:index`); native input methods → `ref.element.*`; `updatePopper` / `focusFirst` etc. gone. Ignore hits on native DOM elements.
`align` / `label-align*` value `left` / `right` → `start` / `end` (BPagination, BCard, BFormGroup, BNav, BTabs, BNavbarNav).
bootstrap-vue TypeScript type. See the type-name map (e.g. `BvTableField` → `TableField`, `BvModalEvent` → `BvTriggerableEvent`, `BvTableCtxObject` → `BTableProviderContext`).
BModal `modal-*` slots were renamed (`modal-footer` → `footer`, `modal-title` → `title`, `modal-ok` → `ok`, …).
BDropdown `dropup`/`dropleft`/`dropright`/`right` were replaced by `placement` (e.g. `placement="bottom-end"`). Also matches BSidebar `right`.
BButton `block` removed in Bootstrap 5: wrap in `<div class="d-grid">`.
Router-link props `append`, `exact`, `exact-path`, `exact-path-active-class`, `event` were removed from link-capable components (Vue Router 4). `exact-active-class` and `active-class` remain.
`html-field` was removed from select / checkbox-group / radio-group / datalist options; use the `option` slot.
BTable slot renamed: `emptyfiltered` → `empty-filtered`, `row-details` → `row-expansion`. Other table slots (`cell(key)`, `head(key)`, `top-row`, `empty`, …) keep their names; check scopes.
`ml/mr/pl/pr-*` → `ms/me/ps/pe-*`.
`*-left/right` → `*-start/end`.
`border/rounded-left/right` → `-start/-end`.
`dropdown-menu-left/right` → `dropdown-menu-start/end`.
`sr-only` → `visually-hidden` (`-focusable`).
`badge-*` → `text-bg-*` (BBadge `variant` still works).
`badge-pill` → `rounded-pill`.
`font-weight-*` → `fw-*`, `font-italic` → `fst-italic`.
`no-gutters` → `g-0` (BRow `no-gutters` prop still accepted).
`form-row`/`form-group`/`form-inline` were removed in Bootstrap 5; use grid + spacing utilities (`row g-2`, `mb-3`).
`custom-*` form classes → `form-select`, `form-check`, `form-switch`, `form-range`, …
`embed-responsive*` → `ratio ratio-16x9`.
Bootstrap 4-only component class (removed in Bootstrap 5).
Bootstrap 5 uses `data-bs-*` attributes (only relevant if you use Bootstrap JS directly).
`text-monospace` → `font-monospace`; `rounded-sm/lg` → `rounded-1/3`.
